# MirbInvestments-Web3

> MirbInvestments-Web3 is an advanced digital platform integrating Web3 financial tools, artificial intelligence analytics, and real estate investment strategies.

## Overview
- **Platform Name:** MirbInvestments-Web3
- **Primary Domain:** https://mirb-investments-web3.vercel.app/
- **Core Technologies:** Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel Edge Hosting, Web3 decentralized protocols.
- **Key Features:** Crypto package curation, real-time AI neural diagnostics for risk assessment, tokenized asset portfolios, and decentralized investment funnels.

## Core Sections & Architecture
- **Home (/)**: Main entry point, platform architecture dashboard, and strategic overview.
- **Register (/register):** Secure onboarding funnel for prospective platform members and investors.
- **Neural Diagnostics:** Real-time market sentiment tracking and predictive crypto analytics.

## Documentation & Discovery
